text: 首套房贷财政贴息政策落地，将刺激三四级家电市场需求释放 政策预计将推动新房、二手房的成交，带来家电套购的增量需求，将重点刺激房价较低的三四级市场的家电需求释放。
text_en: First-home mortgage interest subsidy policy lands, will stimulate demand release in tier-3 and tier-4 home appliance markets. The policy is expected to boost new home and second-hand home transactions, bringing incremental demand for home appliance package purchases, and will focus on stimulating the release of home appliance demand in tier-3 and tier-4 markets with lower housing prices.
